pharma.title: Centre seeks NPPA report on high markups in hospital consumables
pharma.summary: The Union Government has sought a report from the National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) regarding massive markups on medical consumables in private hospitals. Reports indicate markup charges on commonly used hospital supplies range up to 2,841%, prompting regulatory scrutiny.
pharma.source_title: Centre seeks NPPA report on high markups in hospital consumables - The Economic Times

pharma.title: Supreme Court upholds Himachal HC ruling on drug regulator powers
pharma.summary: The Supreme Court has upheld a ruling by the Himachal Pradesh High Court defining the operational jurisdiction and statutory powers of drug inspectors. The judgment directly impacts regulatory enforcement actions conducted by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO).
pharma.source_title: Supreme Court upholds Himachal HC ruling on drug regulator powers, impacting CDSCO enforcement - The Economic Times

pharma.title: Govt strengthens Schedule drugs regulation, recommends CCTV surveillance
pharma.summary: The government has issued revised directives to strengthen regulatory oversight under the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules for Schedule drugs. Recommendations include compulsory CCTV surveillance at retail medical stores to prevent illegal sales of habit-forming formulations.
pharma.source_title: Govt strengthens Schedule drugs regulation, recommends CCTV surveillance at medical stores - thehansindia.com

national.title: India and South Korea to increase bilateral trade to 50 billion dollars by 2030
national.summary: India and South Korea have agreed to scale up their bilateral trade target to $50 billion by 2030. Both nations aim to enhance supply chain resilience, trade diversification, and economic cooperation across strategic industrial sectors.

national.title: India heads into 8th WTO trade policy review with record exports in focus
national.summary: India is set to participate in its 8th World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Policy Review, showcasing record export milestones. The review will assess India's trade practices, regulatory environment, and economic integration over recent years.

national.title: India's 7.8% economic growth reflects citizen resilience, says Finance Minister
national.summary: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted that India's robust GDP growth rate reflects national productivity and targeted fiscal policy. The macroeconomic resilience positions India among the world's fastest-growing major economies.

international.title: US President issues ultimatum to Iran over strategic agreement

environment.title: World Circular Economy Forum 2026 concludes in Gandhinagar
